title: The ridge weather station
paragraphs: The field team divided the ridge {{1}} three observation zones. {{2}} the lower path seemed sheltered, Leena still measured its wind speed rather than assuming it was calm.
At every zone, she used a different marker so that one record would not be confused with {{3}}. Near the summit, the group found a sensor hanging {{4}} after its fastening had shifted.
Arun chose to secure it {{5}} than replace it immediately. He checked the reading {{6}} the class left and wrote down the repair time.
The records would be comparable only {{7}} every group used the same five-minute interval. By the time the final group returned, Leena {{8}} already organised the measurements.
